project_title: 15x15 Strategy Map - Multiplayer Grid War Room
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL WAR-ROOM MINIMALISM

typography.pairing: Space Grotesk (Headings/Display) + JetBrains Mono (Coordinates/Data/Badges/Tokens) + DM Sans (Body/Labels)

entry_surfaces./: tactical war-room map console — top persistent command header with status badge, join/auth & session cockpit panel above the central 15x15 tactical grid with coordinate axis indicators

layout_and_grid_specifications.overall_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8 flex flex-col items-center gap-6

top_command_header.description: Tactical status bar with logo, game title 'TERRA GRID 15×15', active player count badge, and tactical telemetry indicator
top_command_header.style: w-full max-w-4xl flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-4 mb-2

states.logged_out: Tactical Join / Rejoin card with Username Input, 6-digit Password Input (numeric or text), Join/Deploy Button, and contextual helper text / error display
states.logged_in: Active Commander Session banner showing current avatar preview, username, assigned coordinates (e.g., [X: 8, Y: 12]), assigned token color swatch, and a prominent 'Leave Game / Terminate Session' button

join_panel.style: w-full max-w-4xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md

map_grid_15x15.container_layout: relative bg-slate-950/80 border-2 border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 md:p-6 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden

coordinate_labels.top_x_axis: 15 columns labeled 1 through 15 (or A through O) in font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex justify-around mb-2
coordinate_labels.left_y_axis: 15 rows labeled 1 through 15 in font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex flex-col justify-around mr-2

map_grid_15x15.grid_css: grid grid-cols-15 gap-[2px] md:gap-1 bg-slate-800/60 p-1 rounded-lg aspect-square max-w-[620px] w-full mx-auto
map_grid_15x15.cell_style: aspect-square relative rounded-[3px] bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800/80 hover:border-sky-500/60 hover:bg-slate-800/90 transition-all flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none group

avatar_token.design: Circular or rounded-hexagonal high-contrast military tactical token with first letter of username capitalized in bold monospace
avatar_token.size: w-3/4 h-3/4 max-w-[32px] max-h-[32px] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-mono font-bold text-xs shadow-md border
avatar_token.self_highlight: Pulsing radar ring or bright border (e.g., emerald or gold ring with ring-2 ring-emerald-400 ring-offset-1 ring-offset-slate-900 animate-pulse), with distinct 'YOU' mini-indicator or tooltip
avatar_token.others_token: Solid token colored deterministically from user identifier / assigned palette, crisp white initials, subtle border
avatar_token.tooltip: On hover, show mini tooltip with Commander Username and Coordinates e.g. 'Alpha [7, 12]'

motion_and_micro_interactions.token_spawn: Scale-in from 0 to 1 with spring physics (motion/react: initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 20 }})
motion_and_micro_interactions.self_radar_pulse: Subtle repeating sonar/radar sweep border animation for the player's own token to instantly distinguish location on the 225-cell grid
motion_and_micro_interactions.cell_hover: Border glow transitioning to sky-400 (transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease)
motion_and_micro_interactions.error_shake: Gentle horizontal shake when wrong password entered for existing commander (transform: translateX(-4px) -> translateX(4px))
motion_and_micro_interactions.leave_game: Smooth fade-out and reset form inputs back to ready state

accessibility_and_contrast.text_contrast: All text elements exceed APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 against their dark slate backgrounds (Slate-100 #F8FAFC on Slate-900 #0F172A is 14.5:1; Slate-400 #94A3B8 is 6.2:1)
accessibility_and_contrast.token_contrast: Initials on tokens use pure white #FFFFFF with drop-shadow or pure black #000000 depending on token luminosity, ensuring AA contrast ratio
accessibility_and_contrast.focus_states: Visible focus ring with focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-400 focus-visible:outline-none on all inputs and buttons
accessibility_and_contrast.screen_readers: Grid cells have aria-label='Grid cell row {r} col {c}' and if occupied, 'Occupied by {username}'
accessibility_and_contrast.reduced_motion: Wrap pulse and spawn animations in motion-safe queries (@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce))

shadcn_component_usage.Button: @/components/ui/button.tsx — used for 'Deploy / Join Map', 'Leave Game', 'Toggle Coordinates', 'Quick Info'
shadcn_component_usage.Input: @/components/ui/input.tsx — used for Username and 6-digit Password (with inputMode='numeric' or text, maxLength=6)
shadcn_component_usage.Card: @/components/ui/card.tsx — customized with dark war-room border for Join Panel and Active Commander info
shadcn_component_usage.Toaster: @/components/ui/sonner.tsx — used for deployment alerts, wrong password notifications, and rejoining feedback

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend at /app/backend, Vite + React 19 frontend at /app/frontend).
Set dark theme as primary for this strategy war-room aesthetic by ensuring dark mode class in index.html and index.css.
Implement the 15x15 square grid cleanly using Tailwind CSS grid (grid-cols-15 or custom 15 column CSS grid template).

Maintain state in FastAPI with MongoDB (or in-memory cache synchronized with MongoDB) for players: username, 6-digit password hash or verification, assigned (x, y) coordinates (1-15, 1-15), token color index, created_at, last_active.
When a new user joins, pick an empty random square (or random square on the 15x15 board) and assign a distinct token color from the palette.
When an existing user rejoins with the correct password, return their existing position and token color.
When an existing user provides the WRONG password, reject with 401 error message 'Invalid password for commander [username]'.
Ensure your own avatar is highlighted distinctly with the emerald pulse ring and 'YOU' indicator.
Leave Game button clears the client's active session, but their token remains on the shared map until refreshed or per persistence specs.

Scope Guard: Strictly maintain milestone boundary — do NOT add movement controls, attack mechanics, chat, or complex game loops. Keep it focused on the 15x15 map, join/rejoin auth, and multi-avatar rendering.
